rewrites.comment: go_router puts real paths in the address bar, so a refresh on /invoices asks the server for /invoices. Vercel serves a matching file first, so this only catches the app's own routes and never the assets.

headers.comment: Rebuilt on every deploy and not content-hashed. Cached, a shopkeeper keeps running last week's app and reports bugs that were fixed days ago.
The engine and the database runtime. These change only when Flutter or drift is upgraded, and they are the heaviest thing a shop on 3G downloads — worth keeping.
A shop's books. Nothing here should be framed by another site or sniffed into a different content type.
